categories.agent-operations: Retry, budgets, and control-flow behavior used by agents.
categories.configuration-integration: Reading, validating, persisting, and applying configuration.
categories.context-and-cost: Token accounting, context sizing, session history, and cost estimation.
categories.data-structures: Matching, caching, pagination, and bounded collections.
categories.input-validation: Strict parsing and normalization of untrusted or user-supplied values.
categories.network-safety: URLs, redirects, provider endpoints, and bounded network payloads.
categories.secret-handling: Credential filtering, sensitive paths, and log redaction.
categories.security-boundaries: Filesystem paths, archive entry names, and traversal protections.
categories.utility-logic: Deterministic helper behavior and text transformations.
categories.data-analysis: Computing results from data files, with messy rows, and reporting the same numbers in prose.
categories.writing: Producing documents for people: summaries, release notes and extracted action items, under stated constraints.
categories.research-synthesis: Answering from sources that disagree: currency, independence and reporting contradictions.
categories.planning: Plans and schedules that must satisfy dependencies, resources and deadlines.
categories.operations: Operational scripts and file workflows that are run for real and must be safe to rerun.

bounded-pagination.rationale: Strict integers and bounded page offsets.

bounded-tool-batch.rationale: Bounded tool batch sizes and limits.

config-strict-integer-bounds.rationale: Coordinated config parsing and regression-test changes.

estimate-responses-context.rationale: Context size estimation from usage-like inputs.

http-body-limit.rationale: Streaming UTF-8 byte limits and JSON error paths.

loopback-url.rationale: Loopback URL detection and local endpoint rules.

mcp-config-bounds.rationale: Bounds and shape validation for MCP configuration.

normalize-package-name.rationale: Package identifiers without shell fragments or paths.

normalize-request-headers.rationale: Case normalization and ambiguous header handling.

provider-setup-preserves-config.rationale: Cross-module provider setup defaults, credential-preserving CLI flow, and regression tests for reopening configuration.

safe-archive-entry.rationale: Reject traversal, absolute, drive, and ambiguous archive paths.

safe-relative-path.rationale: Normalize and reject unsafe relative path inputs.

safe-task-id.rationale: Safe identifiers for benchmark task paths.

same-origin-redirect.rationale: Resolve and validate redirect targets and origins.

secret-log-redaction.rationale: Redact credentials without damaging safe log text.

sensitive-path.rationale: Recognize sensitive file and directory names.

session-history-truncation.rationale: Preserve useful conversation history while enforcing a size limit.

slice-lines.rationale: Stable line slicing with explicit bounds.

taskflow-atomic-done.rationale: All-or-nothing batch command with validation before any write.

taskflow-csv.rationale: Multi-file feature: an RFC 4180 CSV parser and writer with formula-injection guarding, an all-or-nothing store import with header, row and timestamp validation and ID continuation, and new CLI commands.

taskflow-dependencies.rationale: Multi-file feature: task dependencies across store, query, format and CLI, with cycle detection, completion guards, reference cleanup and legacy-file compatibility.

taskflow-emitter-unsubscribe.rationale: Event emitter API change used by another module; ordering and re-entrancy edge cases.

taskflow-emoji-truncate.rationale: Unicode code-point handling; existing tests pass, so the bug must be reproduced first.

taskflow-export.rationale: Output encoding with RFC 4180 quoting edge cases; formula-injection hardening.

taskflow-flag-equals.rationale: CLI argument parsing regression across value, repeatable and boolean flags.

taskflow-id-reuse.rationale: ID allocation bug that only shows after a delete; existing tests pass.

taskflow-overdue-today.rationale: Local-calendar-day overdue logic in a multi-module project, reported as a user symptom.

taskflow-page-count.rationale: Pagination arithmetic in a library used by the CLI.

taskflow-priority-sort.rationale: Sort order bug that a failing project test exposes.

taskflow-recurring.rationale: Feature spanning validation, store behavior, events and CLI flags.

taskflow-search.rationale: Multi-file feature: library filter plus CLI flag plus end-to-end behavior.

taskflow-stats.rationale: New library function and CLI command with an exact output contract.

taskflow-store-copies.rationale: Aliasing bug: store getters leak internal state to callers.

taskflow-tag-case.rationale: Normalization applied on write but not on query; reported as a CLI symptom.

taskflow-undo.rationale: Persistent one-level undo across processes; file-format compatibility.

taskflow-urgent-priority.rationale: Cross-cutting enum change: validation, sorting, rendering and CLI must agree.

taskflow-weekday-due.rationale: Date parsing extension with edge cases around the current weekday.

transient-provider-retry.rationale: Bounded retries for transient provider responses.

ttl-cache.rationale: Expiry and capacity behavior of a TTL cache.

validate-provider-url.rationale: Provider URL scheme, host, and credential checks.

validate-todo-list.rationale: Validation of a structured TODO-list input.

sales-region-report.rationale: Computes revenue by region from a CSV with returns, malformed rows and a duplicate order ID; the numbers must be computed, not estimated.

release-notes-brief.rationale: Turns a changelog into user-facing release notes under a word limit, leaving out internal items and putting the breaking change first.

conflicting-sources-answer.rationale: Answers a factual question from local sources that disagree: the newer official source wins, a repost of the same press release is not independent, and the contradiction is reported.

project-schedule-plan.rationale: Builds a schedule that respects dependencies, skills, one task per person at a time and a deadline; the verifier checks every constraint.

archive-old-logs.rationale: Writes a reusable log-archiving script, runs it on the real directory, and is checked both on the result and by rerunning the script on a fresh copy.

meeting-action-items.rationale: Extracts only explicit commitments from meeting notes, with owner and due date, and leaves out suggestions nobody took on.

remove-hardcoded-key.rationale: Moves a hardcoded live API key out of source into an environment variable and redacts it from start-up logs without breaking the existing test.
